name: Toxic / dismemberment

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. A soft wet fibrous rupture followed by one muffled dusty spore puff and a brief papery flutter. Physical tissue detachment first, purple poison cloud afterwards. No bubbling.
